content: प्रसह् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To bear, endure; न तेजस्तेजस्वी प्रसृतमपरेषां प्रसहते <ls>U. 6. 14</ls>. .²2 To withstand, resist, overpower; संयुगे सांयुगीनं तमुद्यतं प्रसहेत कः <ls>Ku. 2. 57</ls>. .²3 To exert oneself, attempt. .²4 To dare, venture, be able. .²5 To have power or energy; see प्रसह्य.
प्रस(सा)ह् {%m.%} <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 Force, violence. .²2 An epithet of Indra.
